verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the Bela Vista neighborhood of Sao Paulo, which is home to Avenida Paulista.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel sits in the Bela Vista neighborhood, which is conveniently home to Avenida Paulista

verified_facts.text: Rosewood Sao Paulo is Rosewood's first property in South America.
verified_facts.excerpt:
This is Rosewood’s first property in
South America

verified_facts.text: The interiors were designed by Philippe Starck and the tree-shrouded tower by Jean Nouvel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The striking Philippe Starck-designed interiors, tree-shrouded Jean Nouvel-designed tower

verified_facts.text: The hotel is built into a former maternity ward where half a million Paulistas were born.
verified_facts.excerpt: built this modern design marvel into the interior of a former maternity ward where half a million Paulistas were born

verified_facts.text: The restored 1922 Santa Luzia Chapel is crowned by a stained glass rosette by Vik Muniz and hosts weddings and ceremonies.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 1922 Chapel at Rosewood São Paulo, beautifully restored, honors Italian heritage and serves as a poetic setting for weddings, ceremonies, and timeless celebrations—crowned by a stained glass rosette by Vik Muniz.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a guided tour of the commissioned works of art within the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: A guided tour of the unique commissioned works of art within the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Art was commissioned for spaces from the rooftop pool floor to the elevator interiors, primarily from Brazilian artists and makers.
verified_facts.excerpt: the art commissioned for every space imaginable, from the illustrated rooftop pool floor to the elevator interiors to the custom pillow covers in each room, from primarily Brazilian artists and makers

verified_facts.text: Le Jardin is the hotel's grand cafe, serving from breakfast to late-night bites, with kosher options and garden dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our grand café serving from breakfast to late-night bites, with kosher options and garden dining.

verified_facts.text: Blaise serves French cuisine crafted using Brazilian ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: French cuisine artfully crafted using the finest brazilian ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Taraz centers on wood-fire South American cooking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Central to South American cooking is the wood fire, bringing people and cultures together to feast.

verified_facts.text: Rabo Di Galo offers live music and cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Live music, cocktails, and a sultry ambiance combine for a unique experience.

verified_facts.text: Bela Vista Bar blends cocktails and Mediterranean flavors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Blending cocktails and mediterranean flavors in a stunning ambience

verified_facts.text: The Asaya spa is the first in South America.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Asaya spa, a trademark for the Rosewood brand, is the first in South America.

verified_facts.text: Asaya Crystal Room experiences include guided meditations, Reiki and head massages.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Crystal Room experiences include guided meditations, Reiki, head massages, and more

verified_facts.text: The main pool has a mosaic floor that evokes the rivers of Bonito, with first-come-first-serve cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Head to the gorgeous main pool, painstakingly designed with a mosaic floor that evokes the rivers of Bonito, in nearby Mato Grosso do Sul, where first-come-first-serve cabanas

verified_facts.text: Suites include personalized butler service, designer pieces and marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering a sophisticated residential atmosphere with designer pieces, marble bathrooms, and plush comforts, the urban retreats are further enhanced with personalized butler service.

verified_facts.text: There are two Shabbat suites on the ground level modified to accommodate observers, and the in-room dining menu has a Kosher section.
verified_facts.excerpt: there are two Shabbat suites on the ground level that have been fully modified to accommodate observers, and the in-room dining menu has an entire Kosher section

verified_facts.text: Interior maternity ward rooms around the courtyard can get some noise from the restaurant below.
verified_facts.excerpt: the interior maternity ward rooms sitting around the courtyard are privy to some noise bubbling up from the restaurant below

verified_facts.text: Santa Luzia concerts are held once a month.
verified_facts.excerpt: Once a month, you are invited to contemplate well-orchestrated concerts that will refresh your soul.
